scope: The southern file of three circular windows and the immediately adjacent open half of three balconies above the ground-floor door at 116 Maoming South Road.
control: Three calibrated roadside panorama positions from 2020-02-22. All model dimensions are approximate.

local_axes.z: up from approximate street ground, m

measurements.basis: Triangulation of the same three centres from separate panorama positions after heading and tilt corrections.

measurements.part: outer diameter and clear diameter of surrounding moulding
measurements.basis: Front and oblique views with the centre line held fixed.

measurements.part: selected street pier edges along the frontage
measurements.basis: Cross-checked from three stations. The model ends before the enclosed southern neighbour.
The seam between the open half-bay and the enclosed northern half, visible from the street.

measurements.part: front edge and rear wall depth
measurements.basis: Three-station front edge. Five image samples at the rear-ceiling junction produce 1.54–1.66 m of setback.
Photo sightlines meet the bottom edges. The separate overhead cornice begins at approximately 14.27 m.

measurements.part: top of the solid front parapets
measurements.basis: Image measurements. Mid-level 8.21–8.31 m; the higher thin metal rail is independent.

estimated_detail: Window bar profiles and glass recess, tile pitch, service units, rail sections and rear joinery are interpreted from appearance. The edge immediately north of the open balconies shows glazing. No interiors have been surveyed.
